name: Thunderbloom Blessing: Shatterbolt
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Electro Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
When you have a Catalyzing Field: Your characters' Elemental Bursts cost 2 fewer Elemental Dice. (Once per Round)
